relationships.subject: axotomy
relationships.evidence_quote: the percentage of CGRP+ neurons expressing pSTAT3 increased significantly 2.5-folds after axotomy, preferentially in neurons with large diameters

relationships.subject: non-axotomized C-fibres
relationships.evidence_quote: most of the neurons with ectopic spontaneous activity (39/46) were non-axotomized C-fibres with functional receptive fields in the skin far beyond the site of damage

key_findings: pSTAT3 is induced equally in axotomized and non-axotomized DRG neurons after nerve injury; CGRP expression shifts from small to large neurons.
Most neurons with ectopic spontaneous activity after partial nerve injury are intact C-fibres.
